data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Don't bother. Luxury prince without the luxury service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4577745149117f936b642f)
If you are going to offer samples of wallpaper (free or not, and the price of the wallpaper shouldn't matter for $300 for a roll...) then you need to make it a policy that the entire pattern be included in that sample. Make them bigger. But I ordered one. the pattern was barely in it. I had 3 more sent to "cobble them together" which admittedly was an excellent suggestion, however none arrived with the full pattern. We need it for color selection. We need this to see the scale in our space or project. We need it to get an idea of the $300 a panel wall paper will work in the space. Otherwise you wasting out time and you money on cutting useless samples that show nothing.

June 16, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 6, 2026

Hello,

Thank you for your feedback, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience with the swatch availability from our wallpaper supplier. For styles that are not made to order or final sale, we recommend that you consider ordering a roll of wallpaper to view it in your space, and you can return it once you've made your decision. Please let us know if you have any further questions; we are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
